title: ドラマチックロード 風の発端
description:
■A simulation RPG set in modern Japan!The setting is modern Japan, Kanagawa Prefecture. The characters are all normal, life-sized students and working adults.  A simulation RPG with a unique world view, where you fight with bikes and fists instead of swords and magic!

 
 

■Simultaneous turn-based battles!The game employs a "simultaneous turn-based" system in which the order of enemy and ally actions is jumbled. This is a new type of strategy that tests both impulsive decision-making and long-term strategic thinking.

You can also change the order in which your allies act using the special command "Shift Change." If you master this, you can completely change the course of battle!

■A large number of unique characters appear!Many characters with various skills and unique actions appear! 

Develop your favorite character, utilize their individuality, and defeat powerful enemies! 

 

■A profound scenario consisting of three partsA three-part story depicting the fierce battle that took place over three years at Gyoun High School.  Please enjoy this intense, momentary, and passionate drama about boys and girls.

description_short: A full-fledged SRPG set in modern-day Japan! Use your allies' skills and special abilities to fight through simultaneous turn-based, strategic battles! A story of fierce battles between boys and girls told in three parts!
